card.name: The /kg after mg in steroid dosing
card.fires_on: Mostly the "/kg" right after "mg" in "1 to 2 mg/kg/day prednisone" in immune-therapy label text about interrupting or stopping the drug. Rarely it fires on odd spots inside drug names or lists.
